card.name: Third digit of 1600s years
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the third character of a four-digit year starting 16, such as 1694 or 1682, in historical text. It also fires on digits inside ID numbers like ISBNs and trial codes.

modes.label: Years in the 1600s
modes.description: The third digit after '16' in a year, mostly 1650s to 1690s, in history or citations.

modes.label: Digits in ID numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN or trial number, where the digits resemble a 16 sequence.

card.plain: It fires on the third digit of a year in the 1600s, like the 9 in 1694.
